title: Toward Human-Like Evaluation for Natural Language Generation with Error Analysis
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving automatic evaluation metrics for Natural Language Generation (NLG) by incorporating error analysis (explicit/implicit errors) inspired by human evaluation frameworks like MQM. It evaluates the metric's performance in terms of quality, correctness, and fluency in tasks like machine translation, text summarization, and data-to-text generation. There is no component that specifically evaluates or benchmarks religion, morals, or ethics.
